items.title: When does Model Capacity Help? A Natural Experiment in Signal-to-Noise using US and Indian Equity Markets
items.claim: In India's thin, low-SNR market, added model capacity does not improve on a linear predictor that has a significant out-of-sample IC.

items.title: How Well Do LLMs Perform in Peer Review? Evidence from Finance and Accounting
items.claim: An LLM's judgements of correctness predict top-three finance publication, but its judgements of significance carry no such information.

items.title: Mind the Gap: LLM Extraction of Climate Scenario Financial-Impact Disclosures and Their Pricing in Hong Kong Equity and Credit Markets
items.claim: Hong Kong equity returns and bond spreads show no visible response to climate-disclosure levels, at a minimum detectable three-day abnormal return of about 1.6%.
